title: A message sent now during a batch of tool calls is read at the next model round (Greek)
pins: The owl runs two tool calls from one model reply; the person presses Send now on a waiting message while the first runs. Both calls still run and answer, and the person's exact words arrive as their own message after the whole batch, in the next model round; the message is part of the turn it steered and gets no reply of its own. docs/bots.md, Messages that wait (steering.py).
